titles.romaji: The Humanoid: Ai no Wakusei Lezaria
titles.native: ザ・ヒューマノイド 哀の惑星レザリア

description: Dr. Watson has created his masterpiece – a beautiful woman made of metal. A wonder of science, Antoinette is a childlike innocent who holds the key to an ancient civilization that could save the world, or destroy it. And when a mad tyrant kidnaps the man she loves, Antoinette finally discovers the courage – and the amazing fighting skills – that are her true calling.
